claim: Decoding an identity token is not authentication and a client-side reveal is not authorization. A protected backend must verify signature, audience, issuer and expiry, check the hosted domain when the resource is Workspace-only, and enforce per-site permissions. A static frontend may not be described as an authorized deployment until that exists.
